decisions.question: Should Home's note after a crash offer Put back for files git keeps?
decisions.context: Home's After a crash note (0.105.0) lists files a crash left filled with zeros, with what puts each right. For a file git keeps, the kit's zeroed restore --apply writes the last commit's copy back. A button would be the program's first write into a repository other than starter files.

options.label: A Put back button, after a yes
options.detail: Only files the look named that git keeps; refused while the game runs; any change since the last commit was lost to the crash already

options.label: Keep it to words
options.detail: The note says what puts each right; an agent session or the command line puts it back

decisions.why: After a power cut the fix is known and safe for a file git keeps, and remembering a command is what Home is meant to spare

decisions.question: Which page keeps the V key: the Save explorer or the Explorer?
decisions.context: You chose V for the Save explorer on the Decisions page (save-explorer.md), before the Explorer (0.41.0) took V as an agent's choice. The Save explorer was built tonight (0.121.0) on Shift+V so nothing clashed.

options.label: Explorer keeps V; Save explorer on Shift+V
options.detail: As built tonight; nothing you already press changes

options.label: Save explorer takes V; Explorer moves to Shift+V
options.detail: Your earlier choice; the Explorer's key changes

decisions.why: V already opens the Explorer in your hands; either key can be changed in Settings at any time
